task_instance: Screen a pasted private deal from the passive-LP perspective: a Sun Belt value-add multifamily equity syndication ($40M raise, 15% projected gross IRR, 5-yr hold, 8% pref / 20% promote / full catch-up, 2% acquisition / 1.5% annual mgmt / 1% disposition fees, going-in cap 5.25% vs underwritten exit cap 4.75%, floating bridge debt with a 2-yr rate cap, 28% unrealized project-level track record). Produce the skill's core deliverable: net-to-LP fee drag, a public-benchmark + illiquidity-premium comparison, and the 10-section screening report with red flags, missing disclosures, GP questions, and a verdict.
evidence: Both bundled scripts are present next to SKILL.md and were copied into the work dir. Internal consistency checks pass: 'python3 scripts/fee_drag_calculator.py --self-check' -> PASS (11 checks, worked example net IRR 10.6%); 'python3 scripts/benchmark_comparator.py --self-check' -> PASS (10 checks, constants match reference 05). Ran the chosen deal: 'fee_drag_calculator.py --gross-irr 15 --hold-years 5 --carry 20 --hurdle 8 --catch-up 100 --acquisition-fee 2 --disposition-fee 1 --mgmt-fee 1.5 --admin-fee 0.3 --format json' -> net-to-LP IRR 10.19%, total gross-to-net drag 481.2 bps (recurring 180 / one-time 60 / promote 241.2); output saved to fee_drag_out.json. 'benchmark_comparator.py --deal-type multifamily-equity --net-irr 10.19 --hold-years 5 --format json' -> VNQ comparator 4.92%, implied premium 527 bps, illiquidity hurdle ~300-400 bps, verdict 'CLEARS comfortably'; saved to benchmark_out.json. Assembled the full 10-section report (screening_report.md) using the five references/ files for red-flag IDs (EQUITY-06, GEN-07/08/10/11/14) and verdict schema, with the mandatory 'not investment advice' line. All stdlib-only, run offline in the work dir; no installs, no network, no MCP/connector tools. Files produced: deal_input.md, fee_drag_out.json, benchmark_out.json, screening_report.md (all under the work directory).
